intended_object: The regularized transport (convection) tensor F_{ij}(x,t) = J_i(x,t) U_j(x,t), with J the mollified velocity and U the velocity, whose double Riesz transform gives the pressure in the Leray-regularized Navier–Stokes system. Inferred from the docstring (used by `def:riesz-pressure`), the module RegPressureBound and its use in RegEquicontinuityInputs.
explanation: The body `fun i j z => J z i * U z j` is exactly the component formula J_i U_j of the outer product J ⊗ U, evaluated pointwise in space-time. The order of the factors matches the convention ∂_i∂_j(J_i U_j) for the regularized nonlinearity (J·∇)U. The definition has no degenerate cases or junk values. It is specialized to fields on ℝ³×ℝ with Fin 3 indices, but it is a specific auxiliary object of the 3D Caffarelli–Kohn–Nirenberg/Leray-pressure development and is fed directly to the library's 3D space-time Riesz-pressure operator. It is not a general Mathlib notion written out in a special setting: Matrix.vecMulVec only gives the bare pointwise outer product, and Mathlib has no transport-tensor or Riesz-pressure notion. So it is faithful.
